lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਾ ਅਟਲੁ ਗਣਿਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੰਜੋਗੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: saahaa atal ganiaa pooran sa(n)jogo raam ||
lines.translation: The date for my wedding is set, and cannot be changed; my union with the Lord is perfect.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਹ ਸਮੂਹ ਭਇਆ ਗਇਆ ਵਿਜੋਗੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukhah samooh bhaiaa gaiaa vijogo raam ||
lines.translation: I am totally at peace, and my separation from Him has ended.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਆਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਏ ਬਣੇ ਅਚਰਜ ਜਾਞੀਆਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: mil sa(n)t aae prabh dhiaae bane acharaj jaanjeeaa(n) ||
lines.translation: The Saints meet and come together, and meditate on God; they form a wondrous wedding party.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਹੋਏ ਸਹਜਿ ਢੋਏ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਉਪਜੀ ਮਾਞੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mil ikatr hoe sahaj dhoe man preet upajee maanjeeaa ||
lines.translation: Gathering together, they arrive with poise and grace, and love fills the minds of the bride's family.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: mil jot jotee ot potee har naam sabh ras bhogo ||
lines.translation: Her light blends with His Light, through and through, and everyone enjoys the Nectar of the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭ ਸੰਤਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਜੋਗੋ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak sabh sa(n)t melee prabh karan kaaran jogo ||3||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, the Saints have totally united me with God, the All-powerful Cause of causes. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਵਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵੜਾ ਧਰਤਿ ਸਭਾਗੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhavan suhaavaRaa dharat sabhaagee raam ||
lines.translation: Beautiful is my home, and beauteous is the earth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਅੜਾ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh ghar aaiaRaa gur charanee laagee raam ||
lines.translation: God has entered the home of my heart; I touch the Guru's feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਜਾਗੀ ਸਗਲ ਇਛਾ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur charan laagee sahaj jaagee sagal ichhaa pu(n)neeaa ||
lines.translation: Grasping the Guru's feet, I awake in peace and poise. All my desires are fulfilled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਪੂਰੀ ਸੰਤ ਧੂਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਕੰਤ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: meree aas pooree sa(n)t dhooree har mile ka(n)t vichhu(n)niaa ||
lines.translation: My hopes are fulfilled, through the dust of the feet of the Saints. After such a long separation, I have met my Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨੰਦ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਵਜਹਿ ਵਾਜੇ ਅਹੰ ਮਤਿ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: aana(n)d anadin vajahi vaaje aha(n) mat man kee tiaagee ||
lines.translation: Night and day, the sounds of ecstasy resound and resonate; I have forsaken my stubborn-minded intellect.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak saran suaamee sa(n)tasa(n)g liv laagee ||4||1||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, I seek the Sanctuary of my Lord and Master; in the Society of the Saints, I am lovingly attuned to Him. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਗ ਸੁਲਖਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaag sulakhanaa har ka(n)t hamaaraa raam ||
lines.translation: By blessed destiny, I have found my Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਜਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਧੁਨਿ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: anahad baajitraa tis dhun darabaaraa raam ||
lines.translation: The unstruck sound current vibrates and resounds in the Court of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨੰਦ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਵਜਹਿ ਵਾਜੇ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਉਮਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aana(n)d anadin vajahi vaaje dinas rain umaahaa ||
lines.translation: Night and day, the sounds of ecstasy resound and resonate; day and night, I am enraptured.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਹ ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਨ ਦੂਖੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਤਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tah rog sog na dookh biaapai janam maran na taahaa ||
lines.translation: Disease, sorrow and suffering do not afflict anyone there; there is no birth or death there.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਸੁਧਾ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ridh sidh sudhaa ras a(n)mrit bhagat bhare bha(n)daaraa ||
lines.translation: There are treasures overflowing there - wealth, miraculous powers, ambrosial nectar and devotional worship.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ਵੰਞਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak balihaar va(n)njaa paarabraham praan adhaaraa ||1||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, I am a sacrifice, devoted to the Supreme Lord God, the Support of the breath of life. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਖੀਅ ਸਹੇਲੜੀਹੋ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਹ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun sakhee sahelaReeho mil ma(n)gal gaavah raam ||
lines.translation: Listen, O my companions, and sister soul-brides, let's join together and sing the songs of joy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਰਾਵਹ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan prem kare tis prabh kau raavah raam ||
lines.translation: Loving our God with mind and body, let's ravish and enjoy Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਰਾਵਹ ਤਿਸੈ ਭਾਵਹ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਪਲਕ ਨ ਤਿਆਗੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar prem raavah tisai bhaavah ik nimakh palak na tiaageeai ||
lines.translation: Lovingly enjoying Him, we become pleasing to Him; let's not reject Him, for a moment, even for an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਹਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਈਐ ਨਹ ਲਜਾਈਐ ਚਰਨ ਰਜ ਮਨੁ ਪਾਗੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: gahi ka(n)th laaeeai nah lajaaeeai charan raj man paageeai ||
lines.translation: Let's hug Him close in our embrace, and not feel shy; let's bathe our minds in the dust of His feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਪਾਇ ਮੋਹਹ ਅਨਤ ਕਤਹੂ ਨ ਧਾਵਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat thagauree paai mohah anat katahoo na dhaavah ||
lines.translation: With the intoxicating drug of devotional worship, let's entice Him, and not wander anywhere else.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਅਮਰ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਵਹ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak mil sa(n)g saajan amar padavee paavah ||2||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, meeting with our True Friend, we attain the immortal status. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਮਨ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਈ ਪੇਖਿ ਗੁਣ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: bisaman bisam bhaee pekh gun abinaasee raam ||
lines.translation: I am wonder-struck and amazed, gazing upon the Glories of my Imperishable Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਗਹੀ ਕਟਿ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar gahi bhujaa gahee kat jam kee phaasee raam ||
lines.translation: He took my hand, and held my arm, and cut away the noose of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਲੀਨੑੀ ਦਾਸਿ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਅੰਕੁਰਿ ਉਦੋਤੁ ਜਣਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gahi bhujaa leenhee daas keenhee a(n)kur udot janaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Holding me by the arm, He made me His slave; the branch has sprouted in abundance.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਲਨ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਨਾਠੇ ਦਿਵਸ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: malan moh bikaar naathe divas niramal aaiaa ||
lines.translation: Pollution, attachment and corruption have run away; the immaculate day has dawned.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਨਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: drisat dhaaree man piaaree mahaa duramat naasee ||
lines.translation: Casting His Glance of Grace, the Lord loves me with His Mind; my immense evil-mindedness is dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲੇ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak bhaee niramal prabh mile abinaasee ||3||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, I have become immaculate and pure; I have met the Imperishable Lord God. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਰਜ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਜਲ ਕਾ ਜਲੁ ਹੂਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: sooraj kiran mile jal kaa jal hooaa raam ||
lines.translation: The rays of light merge with the sun, and water merges with water.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਲੀ ਸੰਪੂਰਨੁ ਥੀਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: jotee jot ralee sa(n)pooran theeaa raam ||
lines.translation: One's light blends with the Light, and one becomes totally perfect.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਦੀਸੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਏਕੁ ਏਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: braham deesai braham suneeai ek ek vakhaaneeai ||
lines.translation: I see God, hear God, and speak of the One and only God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਕਰਣਹਾਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: aatam pasaaraa karanahaaraa prabh binaa nahee jaaneeai ||
lines.translation: The soul is the Creator of the expanse of creation. Without God, I know no other at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap karataa aap bhugataa aap kaaran keeaa ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer. He created the Creation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak seee jaanahi jinhee har ras peeaa ||4||2||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, they alone know this, who drink in the subtle essence of the Lord. ||4||2||
